title: Jupiter
text: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system, a gas giant composed primarily of hydrogen and helium. It has a strong magnetic field, at least 95 known moons (including the four large Galilean moons), and a prominent storm called the Great Red Spot, larger than Earth, that has persisted for centuries. Jupiter's immense gravity plays a role in shielding the inner solar system from some comets and asteroids.
